text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"SHAFT"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"2) STRAIGHTNESS:-0.2mm/1000mm MAX."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"3) RUNOUT:-0.1mm/1000mm."}],"comment":"The drawing calls out tight straightness and runout over a 999.5 mm length (D13), which requires turning between centres, yet no centre holes are specified on either end of the shaft. Without defined centre holes the machinist has no datum to hold the part accurately, risking scrap or rework. The designer should add standard centre hole callouts (e.g., per ISO 6411) at both ends of the shaft.","recommended_correction":"Add centre hole specifications at both ends of the shaft."}]}
